policy_summarization.output:
• All institutional web content, course management systems, and instructional documents must be fully accessible to individuals with disabilities.
• Remediation requests for inaccessible documents must be processed by campus departments within 3 business days of receipt.
• Compliance is governed by Title II of the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and WCAG 2.1 Level AA standards.

• Educational records cannot be disclosed to third-party commercial cloud vendors without prior written student consent.
• There are explicit statutory exemptions under data-perimeter safety rules that allow for disclosure without consent.
• FERPA affords eligible students certain rights with respect to their education records.

- In accordance with Title II of the ADA and WCAG 2.1 Level AA, all institutional web content, course management systems, and instructional documents must be fully accessible.
- Remediation requests for inaccessible documents must be processed by campus departments within 3 business days of receipt.
- Compliance with these standards ensures equal access for individuals with disabilities.

- FERPA grants students rights over their education records.
- Disclosure to third-party commercial cloud vendors requires prior written student consent.
- Statutory exemptions allow for data-perimeter safety rules without consent.
